title: Verify: ENH-1: Confidence scoring on memory records
summary: Re-verify confidence field, Pydantic range enforcement, min_confidence filtering in list_all/search against ENH-1 acceptance criteria.
comments: VER-8 PASS. confidence field (float, ge=0.0, le=1.0, default=1.0) on _MemoryBase via Pydantic v2 Field. Migration 0003: DOUBLE NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0 on all 5 tables. create() INSERTs confidence at col-8 position; update() SETs confidence = ? including record.confidence value. _model_from_row() reads confidence as float(row[8]) if not None else 1.0 (pre-migration rows default to 1.0). min_confidence in list_all() and search(): when > 0.0 appends 'AND confidence >= ?' as bound param; when 0.0 (default) NO predicate added (backward compat). Predicate appears in ROW_NUMBER pagination path too. 17 unit tests in TestConfidenceScoring — all pass. Consolidator docstring updated to show confidence usage examples.
